name: peru-payroll
description: Prepare ordinary private-sector Peru payroll for 2026, from remuneration and time records to fifth-category withholding, pension deductions, employer health contributions, net pay and filing reconciliation. Use for planilla, nómina, sueldo neto, gross to net, T-Registro, PLAME Form 0601, ONP, AFP, EPS, overtime, minimum wage, gratificaciones, CTS and employment-tax adjustments. Covers the October minimum-wage change, month-specific AFP components, actual withholding allocation, multiple employers, variable remuneration and cessation. Distinguishes employee liabilities from employer costs and bank payments from accepted filings. Ask for period, affiliation, tax domicile, remuneration components and cumulative records before computing. Special labour regimes, foreign social-security exemptions and unresolved source periods require their own documented assessment.
